value.name: graph-registration
value.premises: Registration operations consume immutable public records, diagnostic graph values and a declared deterministic public verifier. The verifier Debug and inputs contain public evidence only; no secret key or cryptographic implementation is admitted. Trace retains complete arguments and results, including refusals. Typed graph values are compared against reconstruction; serde bytes are diagnostic only and never canonical or binding equality. Observation supplies accounting only and never feeds computation.
